cat /tmp/share-results.txt; printf '\nREMOTE_END_1:%d\n' $?
clarice update [-y] [--check] [--source PATH_OR_HTTP_URL]
Updates standard tools, adds new tools, then updates and relaunches Core.
Source: /etc/clarice/update.conf (HTTP URL or absolute mounted-file path). Catalog: /etc/clarice/installed.catalog.
Interrupted updates retain completed tools; repeat the command to resume.
Private HTTP uses CRC-32 for corruption detection, not authentication.
Unlisted files and preferences are preserved. Newer versions are not downgraded.
PARTIAL=1
MARKER=0
RESUME=0
COMPLETE=0
free [-b|-k|-m|-h] [--]
Report installed RAM and Clarice's current application heap.
Default -k: KiB; -b: bytes; -m: MiB; -h: human readable. Last wins.
Free and largest blocks are not machine-wide free physical RAM.
After-purge values include reclaimable purgeable handles; no purge is
requested. Heap extent excludes the application stack/code outside it;
System 6 partition-wide capacity is not claimed. Values include this
command's temporary image. No Linux swap/buffers/process statistics.
Example: free -b
Status: 0 success, 1 query/output error, 2 invalid option. See status.
CORRUPT=1
